title: MAX_SUPPLY can be bypassed due to missing check in USDA.sol
labels: bug; 3 (High Risk); low quality report; nullified
body_preview: # Lines of code  https://github.com/code-423n4/2023-07-amphora/blob/main/core/solidity/contracts/core/USDA.sol#L172   # Vulnerability details  ## Impact  In UFragments.sol, MAX_SUPPLY variable is initialized which means that the token supply can't go higher. However, in USDA.sol, it's not forced so that the _totalSupply variable must be less than MAX_SUPPLY. For example, in _mint() function, _totalSupply is just increased and there is no appropriate check to make sure that it's below MAX_SUPPLY.
